points.quote: Contract cheating involves using a third party to produce a piece of academic work on your behalf.
points.gist: Contract cheating means using a third party to produce academic work on your behalf.

points.quote: it has become a growing problem thanks to commercial essay mills and the use of artificial intelligence (AI).
points.gist: Contract cheating has become a growing problem thanks to commercial essay mills and the use of AI.

points.quote: Use of Artificial Intelligence for example, may produce a similarity score of 0% but staff will recognize the signs of AI generated text, such as the departure from your usual style of writing.
points.gist: AI use may give a 0% similarity score, but staff will recognise signs of AI text such as departure from your usual style.

points.quote: There is no ‘safe’ similarity score and you should be aware of that.
points.gist: There is no safe similarity score.

points.quote: Students have the opportunity to use this software with draft versions of assignments.
points.gist: Students can use Turnitin with draft versions of assignments.

points.quote: Academic Misconduct can result in your withdrawal from your course.
points.gist: Academic misconduct can result in withdrawal from your course.

points.quote: If you feel that you need more help or don’t understand, then please get in touch with your personal tutor, module tutor, or programme leader, or the Learning Skills team in the Library.
points.gist: If you need more help or don't understand, contact your personal tutor, module tutor, programme leader or the Library Learning Skills team.
